name: balance_white keeps concurrent actors' damage clamps isolated
contract: BalanceWhiteGuard used to hold one process-wide protected set replaced wholesale by Protect()/Clear(); when two actors ran balance_white at the same time (as the balance suite does across lanes on one worldserver), one actor's Protect/Clear call could unprotect the other actor's victim mid-measurement, letting an unclamped swing kill it and hang the case until the scenario timeout (observed in the balance-35-20/40 exploratory smoke runs, failure_actors showing the fighter at health 0, out of combat). The guard now reference-counts guarded guids per call instead of replacing the whole set, so two actors' balance_white runs never interfere. This scenario drives two unrelated CoA-class players through balance_white in lockstep against separate level 36 Scarlet Soldiers in their own instances, asserting both measure a full swing set and both stay alive throughout.
